_readme: Carrier answers to the call-forwarding codes, used by mobile/test/call_forward_parser_test.dart AND backend ForwardingIT. source=real only for text captured on a real SIM (long-press the Call forwarding tile -> Copy). source=emulator: captured on the Android emulator (real Android telephony code, simulated network) - real Android output but no carrier, does not count toward the 3.4 gate. Typed or invented text MUST be source=synthetic; it never counts toward the 3.4 gate (>=10 real rows). Mask phone numbers (every digit -> 9).
